name: Custom: Charge the EV with at least 8 kWh a
description: Synthesized [ev] skill: Charge the EV with at least 8 kWh after 10pm, never pay above $0.28/kWh

note.default: Charge the EV with at least 8 kWh after 10pm, never pay above $0.28/kWh

intent.raw: Charge the EV with at least 8 kWh after 10pm, never pay above $0.28/kWh

sample_out.requirement: Charge the EV with at least 8 kWh after 10pm, never pay above $0.28/kWh

savings_formula: domain=ev: kwh = float(params.get('target_kwh', 8.0)); hour = int(params.get('schedule_hour', 14)); cap = float(params.get('max_price', 0.28)); peak = 0.52 if 16 <= hour <= 20 else (0.12 if (hour >= 22 or hour < 6) else 0.28); savings = round(max(0.0, (0.52 - peak)) * kwh, 2) if peak <= cap else 0.0
